name: AJAS (AI Job Application System)
install: if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else echo 'skip install: .cursor/install.sh not on this ref'; fi
start: if [ -f .cursor/start.sh ]; then bash .cursor/start.sh; else echo 'skip start: .cursor/start.sh not on this ref'; fi

terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Azure Functions host (API + workers) on http://localhost:7071/api. Depends on Azurite from start.sh.
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && source .venv/bin/activate && cd backend && func start

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React UI on http://localhost:3000 (proxies /api to the backend).
